mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte wasting (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia); lansoprazole may further reduce magnesium absorption, compounding hypomagnesemia risk and increasing cardiac arrhythmia potential.
action: Monitor serum magnesium, potassium, and renal function closely during concurrent use; consider magnesium supplementation and evaluate PPI necessity during amphotericin B therapy.
